title: Ordination of Priests and Teachers
summary: The disciples pray to the Father in Christ’s name, lay their hands upon those being ordained, and speak the ordination formula for a priest or teacher. They ordain priests and teachers in this manner.

explicit_facts.text: The disciples were called the elders of the church and ordained priests and teachers.
After praying to the Father in the name of Christ, the disciples laid their hands upon those being ordained and spoke.
The ordination words name Jesus Christ and designate the person as a priest or teacher, with a charge to preach repentance and remission of sins through Jesus Christ.
The disciples ordained priests and teachers according to the gifts and callings of God, by the power of the Holy Ghost which was in them.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A group of disciples performs a hand-laying ordination over one or more recipients.
unspecified_visual_details: The identities and number of those ordained; their appearance; the setting; the disciples’ arrangement and gestures beyond laying hands; any visible representation of the Holy Ghost.

spoken_dialogue.text: In the name of Jesus Christ I ordain you to be a priest,
spoken_dialogue.speaker: a disciple (elder of the church)

spoken_dialogue.text: I ordain you to be a teacher, to preach repentance and remission of sins through Jesus Christ, by the endurance of faith on his name to the end. Amen.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: a disciple (elder of the church)

narration.text: The manner which the disciples, who were called the elders of the church, ordained priests and teachers—

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse gives alternative ordination wording for a priest or a teacher; it does not establish that both alternatives are spoken to one recipient.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a visible Holy Ghost manifestation; the text does not describe its appearance.
Do not assign names or biographies to the ordained people.
